fp32_error_budget.transcendental_assumption: Bounded stable exp/sigmoid/softplus inputs; conservative working gate2e-6/beta1e-6 budgets include approximation. Not a proven MLX libm/fast-math bound.
fp32_error_budget.fast_math: Pinned API documents omitted compile_options.math_mode default safe. Original factory omits it. Effective compiler/driver setting NOT_OBSERVED; no flag changes.
fp32_error_budget.masked_trace_scope: Independent oracle computes counterfactual proposals even at false masks; these traces do not claim kernel arithmetic executed at false masks.

derived_plan_rule: Only declared case arrays sliced at recorded offsets/lengths. Cache and mutation compositions reuse these inputs; no newly varied driving inputs.
barriers: No step evaluation/tracing/host materialization. One returned output/state outer barrier per invocation plus explicit before/after cache observation barriers. Deliberate illicit-inner mutant is separately named.
counts: Actual Python source/factory entries, factory API calls, submitted custom-kernel APIs and explicit barriers; compiled physical counts NOT_MEASURABLE.
masked_contract: CPU ops computes masked output before restoring state; GPU custom kernel zeroes masked output and retains state. Only unmasked output/state parity is claimed. Exact caller is unmasked/vector-only.
